name: TG EAPCET · photograph and signature
applicationPath: 2026 online application · manual photo/signature upload when prompted
coverage: Entered-name/DOB consistency and separate JPEG photograph/signature byte checks.
limitations: This pack covers the 2026 application guide, not the 2027 cycle or admission eligibility.
Some qualifying-examination records supply images automatically. Upload only when the official form prompts you.
The guide does not specify universal pixel dimensions. Photo content, signature authenticity, and portal acceptance are not checked.

sources.title: TG EAPCET 2026 online application user guide
sources.note: The guide specifies JPG photograph below 50 KB and JPG signature below 30 KB for applicants asked to upload them. No minimum byte size is stated.

imageConstraints.label: TG EAPCET photograph · below 50 KB
imageConstraints.limitation: Strictly below 50 KB. Pixel dimensions are a user-selected setting, not an official requirement.

imageConstraints.label: TG EAPCET signature · below 30 KB
imageConstraints.limitation: Strictly below 30 KB. Check signature legibility yourself.

manualChecks: Check that you selected the exact application cycle and upload field.
Review sharpness, framing, orientation and readability yourself.
Confirm the live portal instructions before submitting. Passing file checks does not guarantee acceptance.
